deadline.value: No deadline is stated on the mechanical engineering page.

gre_general.value: The mechanical engineering PhD requires official GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit official GRE scores

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to mechanical engineering.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: A B.S. in mechanical engineering or a closely related field is enough, and an M.S. holder is also admitted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a minimum of a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field

also.quote: Applicants with a M.S. in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field, must have a minimum graduate GPA of 3.250.

notes: Ph.D. option in Mechanical Engineering; an Aerospace doctoral option sits on the same program page. Applicants whose native language is not English must take the TOEFL, with no threshold given.
